corrections.original: JSON search is not faster than JavaScript in 8 to 16 workers.
corrections.fix: True for ordinary patterns (8 workers RegExp 1.9-6.7 ms, 16 workers 1.3-4.0 ms vs GPU 4.5-5.2 ms back to back, 11-16 ms after a pause), but the backtracking pattern (279/136 ms in 8/16 workers) is still beaten by the GPU's 5-12 ms. Nuance added, not a reversal.
